remarks: Casa Gateway AFFORDABLE CONDOS FOR SENIORS. Amazing 3rd floor facing courtyard condo at the corner of Sunset Boulevard and Palisades Drive. One-bedroom, walk-in closet, one bath condo, new carpet and recently painted. Tree top and courtyard garden views from kitchen and Living room balcony. Community laundry room on each floor. Beautiful common area with tables and sofas, restricted access to residences. Well maintained grounds that include a covered patio and a picnic area with large picnic tables and benches. Two cars tandem assigned parking. Located across from the Self-Realization Lake Shrine and Palisades Highlands shopping center with restaurants, Starbucks and more. Close to Palisade
